title: ArchitectureProposal
description: Deterministic architecture proposal artifact generated by the Phase 22 AI Architecture Agent. In --mock mode this is a deterministic scaffold; live model calls are disabled unless both --allow-model-call and AGENT_MANAGER_AI_ENABLE_MODEL_CALLS=1 are present.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this architecture proposal format.

feature_id.description: Feature identifier derived from the source feature brief title slug.

source_feature_brief_path.description: Path to the FEATURE_BRIEF.json that this proposal is based on.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the architecture proposal.

architecture_status.description: Current status of the architecture proposal.

problem_summary.description: Summary of the problem this architecture addresses.

files_likely_involved.description: Files likely to be involved in implementation.

interfaces_and_contracts.description: Interfaces and contracts that need definition.

data_artifacts.description: Data artifacts to be created or modified.

safety_risks.description: Safety risks identified in the proposed design.

constraints.description: Constraints that apply to the architecture.

out_of_scope.description: Items explicitly out of scope for this architecture.

questions_for_human.description: Questions that require human review or clarification.

model_call_allowed.description: Whether a model call was allowed during generation.

model_called.description: Whether a live model was called during generation.

source_writes_performed.description: Whether source writes to target project repos were performed.

openhands_executed.description: Whether OpenHands was executed during generation.
